en.topic_title: Security chief Chris Tang says gov’t will facilitate Wang Fuk Court fire anniversary events if ‘lawful’
en.topic_summary:
Authorities will assist people wishing to commemorate the victims of the Wang Fuk Court blaze on the tragedy’s anniversary later this month, on the condition that such activities are “lawful,” Hong Kong security chief Chris Tang has said.



Secretary for Security Chris Tang. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Tang made the remarks when addressing reporters at an event on Thursday, some three weeks ahead of the first anniversary of the deadly fire. The blaze broke out on November 26 last
